headline: CNH Earnings Were So Good They Pulled Deere Stock Up
summary: Monday, CNH announced earnings per share of 13 cents from sales of $4.8 billion. Wall Street was looking for 10 cents and $4.8 billion, respectively.

headline: CNH Industrial (CNH) Q2 Earnings and Revenues Beat Estimates
summary: CNH (CNH) delivered earnings and revenue surprises of +18.18% and +0.78%, respectively, for the quarter ended June 2026. Do the numbers hold clues to what lies ahead for the stock?
